system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Before each skill runs, SciFlow equips it with a tailored SciMem view, providing the evidence, prior failures or lessons needed for that skill without exposing the full memory graph.
system_prompt_style.note: Skill-based Claude Code prompts composed per stage from memory context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: This structure allows later skills to retrieve scientific context by entity type and relation, instead of relying only on unstructured keyword search.
env_context_strategy.note: Memory-graph context injection plus Claude Code tool-driven navigation (Read/Write/Edit/Bash).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: SciFlow records stage outputs, lifecycle states, links, and pipeline-level progress outside the transient LLM context
context_compaction.note: /dream can 'compress redundant material'; no explicit truncation code seen.

observation_format.evidence_quote: In implementation, each entity is stored as a.mdpage.

tool_call_format.note: Runs on Claude Code, whose tools use the Anthropic tool-call API.

tool_count.note: Count of the tools listed for the CI Claude Code configuration; local interactive default tool set not enumerated in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Claude Code Write (full file) and Edit (string replacement).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: AutoSci runs on **Claude Code**, which speaks the **Anthropic API** protocol.
protocol_standardization.note: Anthropic API protocol compatibility; no MCP evidence in provided files.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: SciFlow decomposes a project into five stages,Literature,Ideation,Experiment,Writing, andRebuttal.
loop_primitives.note: Default is the five-stage /research pipeline over Claude Code react loops; SciDAG adds branching multi-agent graphs; /refine is iterative review-repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `/paper-plan` | Compile a paper outline from the idea graph — evidence map → narrative structure → section + figure + citation plan
planning_granularity.note: Lifecycle-state entities and PAPER_PLAN artifacts persist plans across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each node vi∈Vinstantiates an operatoro i∈Owith a specialized sub-agent and produces an intermediate output from upstream node outputs.
multi_agent_topology.note: /research orchestrates stage skills; SciDAG runs specialized sub-agent operators.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: instantiates an operatoro i∈Owith a specialized sub-agent

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `/research` | End-to-end research orchestrator — idea discovery → experiment design → execution → verdict → paper writing with human gates

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each active entity carries an explicit lifecycle state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: SciMem provides schema-governed research memory, separating Long-Term Knowledge Memory for reusable scientific knowledge from Active Research Memory
long_term_memory.note: Markdown wiki pages persist across projects; SciFlow skills and SciDAG templates are versioned reusable procedures.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: SciFlow records stage outputs, lifecycle states, links, and pipeline-level progress outside the transient LLM context, making projects resumable from a specified stage.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Form checks are handled by deterministic linting, while content checks are handled by an independent reviewer agent.
self_verification.note: /exp-eval runs experiments and judges results; /review and /refine add cross-model critique.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `/refine` | Multi-round iterative improvement — repeatedly calls `/review`, parses feedback, applies fixes, and updates wiki until target score

rollback.evidence_quote: `/reset` | Destructive cleanup — reset wiki state to a clean scaffold by scope (`wiki / raw / log / checkpoints / all`)
rollback.note: Only a destructive reset; no per-action rollback registered. SciEvolve applies 'reversible' metadata only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The workflow currently uses `--max-turns 100`, which fits one paper.
termination_condition.note: max_turns in the CI path; interactive runs end when the skill completes.

cost_controls.note: Separate cheaper subagent/haiku models configurable; no token budget found in evidence.

execution_isolation.note: Runs locally via Claude Code Bash; `/exp-run --env remote` uses ssh/rsync to a remote GPU server.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
Note: native Windows is supported for the local pipeline. Remote-GPU
experiments via `/exp-run --env remote` rely on `ssh`/`rsync`/`screen`
filesystem_access.note: Local host filesystem access through Claude Code.

network_policy.evidence_quote: `/novelty` | Multi-source novelty verification via WebSearch + Semantic Scholar + wiki + Review LLM
network_policy.note: Free web/API access; no network restriction mechanism in evidence.

permission_model.note: Claude Code settings.local.json permissions allowlist; example config shipped.

tracing.note: signals.jsonl, proposals.jsonl, run directories and append-only wiki/log.md.

replayability.evidence_quote:
Finalization reuses the prepared run directory with
`--run-dir`, so the response is validated against the same context Claude saw.
replayability.note: Saved contexts/responses can be re-fed; no full trajectory replay.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `/exp-run` | Full experiment execution pipeline — prepare code → deploy → monitor → collect results
eval_hooks.note: Experiment execution/eval pipeline is in-repo; no standard benchmark harness.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
Each write is assigned PASS,
WARN, or BLOCK; blocked artifacts are quarantined until resolved.
guardrails.note: Trust Guard blocks memory writes; workflow rejects Claude-side edits outside the declared response.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AutoSci is a memory-centric agentic system that automates the full research lifecycle — from paper ingestion to rebuttal

open_source.evidence_quote: [MIT](LICENSE) — use it, fork it, build on it.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: AutoSci runs on Claude Code, which supports any Anthropic-protocol-compatible provider — DeepSeek, Kimi, MiMo, GLM, and more.
